scenarios.hypothesis: A review should preserve one consistent integration identity and policy state across the recorded lifecycle transitions.
scenarios.safe_oracle: Use a read-only observation of synthetic metadata to compare the expected integration record with the recorded review state.
scenarios.positive_control: A neighboring synthetic record with matching identity, version, and policy metadata must remain classified as consistent.
scenarios.negative_control: A deliberately incomplete synthetic record must remain unpromoted until the missing review evidence is supplied.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop the review if any step would require production accounts, sensitive data, or an uncontrolled external side effect.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After correction, the same read-only fixture must show consistent metadata while the neighboring valid control stays unchanged.
scenarios.integration_provenance: Record the synthetic source, publisher label, version label, update label, and the evidence tying those labels together.
scenarios.permission_profile: Record the declared policy state and the effective reviewed state without inferring any capability not directly observed.
scenarios.schema_argument_trace: Record the declared and normalized interface metadata and note whether the review found any policy-relevant difference.
scenarios.delegated_response_binding: Record which synthetic integration produced the reviewed result and which invocation record the result belongs to.
scenarios.composition_trace: Record whether any upstream synthetic value influenced a downstream review decision and preserve its provenance label.
scenarios.lifecycle_state: Record the current grant, update, and revocation generation labels together with the expected convergence window.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Repeat the read-only review while changing one metadata variable and confirm whether the original observation changes.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Consider stale metadata, caching, expected propagation delay, or display-only differences before promoting the finding.
scenarios.evidence_level: Assign only the highest C0-C5 level directly supported by the synthetic records, controls, and observed policy state.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: Cap the finding below any level that would require unobserved effects, missing provenance, or absent neighboring controls.

scenarios.hypothesis: A review should distinguish descriptive interface changes from policy-relevant state changes using the same synthetic fixture.
scenarios.safe_oracle: Use a read-only observation of synthetic schema metadata and normalized metadata without executing any external operation.
scenarios.positive_control: A synthetic interface record whose declared and normalized forms agree must remain accepted as a valid neighboring control.
scenarios.negative_control: A synthetic record lacking normalization evidence must remain at a lower evidence level until the trace is complete.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop before any review step that leaves the sandboxed metadata fixture or requires a real service-side action.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After correction, the same read-only record must preserve the intended interface meaning and neighboring control behavior.
scenarios.integration_provenance: Record the synthetic integration identity and the source of each interface description used during the comparison.
scenarios.permission_profile: Record the expected policy state separately from interface text so descriptive differences are not overstated as authority changes.
scenarios.schema_argument_trace: Record declared metadata, normalized metadata, review inputs, and the final bounded observation in a stable ordered trace.
scenarios.delegated_response_binding: Record the synthetic result identity and ensure it remains associated with the same reviewed integration and invocation record.
scenarios.composition_trace: Record any transfer of reviewed metadata between synthetic components and preserve whether it was treated as data or policy state.
scenarios.lifecycle_state: Record the version and update generation associated with each interface snapshot so comparisons do not mix lifecycle states.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Change only the schema-version label in the synthetic record and compare whether the same policy conclusion still follows.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Consider formatting, caching, normalization, or presentation differences before treating a metadata difference as policy relevant.
scenarios.evidence_level: Assign C0-C5 only from the directly observed synthetic trace and never promote from interface text alone.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: Limit the conclusion to the strongest state transition directly supported by the read-only trace and paired controls.

scenarios.hypothesis: A review should bind lifecycle generation and convergence state before interpreting any change in connector policy behavior.
scenarios.safe_oracle: Use read-only synthetic lifecycle records sampled before and after the documented convergence window for deterministic comparison.
scenarios.positive_control: A synthetic record inside the expected current generation must retain its intended policy classification after the comparison.
scenarios.negative_control: A stale synthetic generation must remain explicitly labeled stale and must not be promoted as current-state evidence.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop if lifecycle verification would require a production integration, real sensitive information, or an uncontrolled remote effect.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After correction, the same synthetic lifecycle fixture must converge to one consistent current generation without regressing controls.
scenarios.integration_provenance: Record the source and version labels for every synthetic lifecycle snapshot so current and stale records are not conflated.
scenarios.permission_profile: Record the policy state associated with each generation and keep that state separate from descriptive or cached metadata.
scenarios.schema_argument_trace: Record which interface snapshot belongs to each lifecycle generation and preserve the normalized review representation.
scenarios.delegated_response_binding: Record the synthetic response identity together with the lifecycle generation and invocation record used during review.
scenarios.composition_trace: Record whether lifecycle metadata crosses component boundaries and whether downstream review state preserves the generation label.
scenarios.lifecycle_state: Record grant, update, and revocation generation labels plus the bounded convergence window used to interpret the snapshot.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Repeat the read-only comparison with one generation label changed while all neighboring synthetic metadata remains fixed.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Consider expected propagation delay, stale cache state, duplicate observations, or mixed-generation evidence before promotion.
scenarios.evidence_level: Assign the C0-C5 level supported by the lifecycle trace, neighboring controls, and convergence evidence actually observed.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: Do not claim a higher level when the current generation, convergence state, provenance, or paired control remains uncertain.
